title: YOU ARE THE LIGHT
OF THE WORLD
end: The Morning Altar — begin every sunrise in prayer
stock_queries: golden sunrise over misty pine forest
close up of dew on morning grass in sunlight
soft light glowing on a wooden table
cinematic sunrise over calm lake horizon
gentle sun flare through morning tree branches

scenes.a: The heavy doubt resting on your chest this hour belongs at the feet of Jesus.
Ye are the light of the world.
A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.
Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
Lord, remove the fear of being seen and help us reflect Your radiance today. Amen.
